# SOP-P2-L3-03 First-article inspection - Machining line

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P2, line P2-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L3-RR01, EQ-P2-L3-HT02, EQ-P2-L3-IH03  
Related: MM-P2-L3-HT02-S3, QS-PROC-09, SB-1003

1. Purpose
1.1 Perform first-article inspection for parts produced on line P2-L3 per quality requirements in QS-PROC-09 and setup guidance in MM-P2-L3-HT02-S3.

2. Preconditions
2.1 Verify equipment identification for all stations: EQ-P2-L3-RR01, EQ-P2-L3-HT02, EQ-P2-L3-IH03.  
2.2 Confirm material lot and traveler are present and match SB-1003 documentation.  
2.3 Ensure calibration status of measurement instruments per QS-PROC-09.

3. PPE
3.1 Wear appropriate PPE as required by plant rules: safety glasses, hearing protection, cut-resistant gloves, and steel-toe footwear.  
3.2 Use heat-resistant gloves when interacting with heated billets at EQ-P2-L3-IH03.

4. Setup checks
4.1 Confirm mandrel seating and roll alignment on EQ-P2-L3-RR01. The mandrel clamp bolt torque for Machining radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L3-RR01) is 470 N·m.  
4.2 Confirm heater control and thermocouple feedback active on EQ-P2-L3-IH03. The target billet temperature for Machining induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P2-L3-IH03) is 1175 °C.  
4.3 Verify cutter and tool offsets at EQ-P2-L3-HT02 match program offsets referenced in MM-P2-L3-HT02-S3.

5. Inspection procedure
5.1 Produce a first-article part following the production program for P2-L3.  
5.2 Perform dimensional inspection per QS-PROC-09. Record all measured characteristics on the first-article report.  
5.3 Match metallurgical and surface condition checks to SB-1003 acceptance criteria.

6. Nonconformance
6.1 If any characteristic fails, stop the line and notify Quality per QS-PROC-09. Document disposition and corrective actions.

7. Records
7.1 File first-article report, instrument calibration tags, and any deviation records in the document control system per QS-PROC-09.

8. Sign-off
Inspector: ______________________  
Print name: ______________________  
Date: ______________________  
Approval (Line Supervisor): ______________________
